nodes.name: 10K Run
nodes.description: Short road races and fun runs

nodes.name: Paris
nodes.description: Art, cuisine, and iconic landmarks on the Seine.

metadata.overview: Prepare for metro navigation, museum timed tickets, and modest dress at churches. Spring and fall offer mild weather and shorter queues at the Louvre and Eiffel Tower.

nodes.name: Tokyo
nodes.description: High-tech capital blending tradition and neon districts.

metadata.overview: Get a Suica/PASMO card, learn basic transit etiquette, and book popular restaurants early. Cherry blossom (Mar–Apr) and autumn foliage (Nov) are peak seasons.

nodes.name: Bali
nodes.description: Tropical island of temples, rice terraces, and beaches.

metadata.overview: Pack for humidity, arrange airport transfer, and respect temple sarong rules. Dry season (Apr–Oct) is ideal for outdoor activities and diving.

nodes.name: New York City
nodes.description: Global hub of finance, Broadway, and world-class museums.

metadata.overview: Book Broadway tickets ahead, use OMNY/subway apps, and plan borough-specific days. Fall foliage in Central Park and holiday season are busiest.

nodes.name: London
nodes.description: Historic capital with royal sites and diverse neighborhoods.

metadata.overview: Oyster/contactless works on TfL. Book Tower of London and West End shows early. UK plug adapters and rain layers are essentials year-round.

nodes.name: Rome
nodes.description: Ancient ruins, Vatican City, and trattoria culture.

metadata.overview: Reserve Colosseum and Vatican skip-the-line slots. Dress shoulders/knees for churches. August is hot and many locals leave the city.

nodes.name: Dubai
nodes.description: Desert metropolis of skyscrapers and luxury shopping.

metadata.overview: Respect local customs (modest dress in malls/mosques). Summer heat is extreme; Nov–Mar is pleasant. Friday–Saturday weekend affects hours.

nodes.name: Barcelona
nodes.description: Gaudí architecture, Mediterranean beaches, and tapas.

metadata.overview: Book Sagrada Família timed entry, watch belongings on La Rambla, and learn Catalan/Spanish basics. Late dinners are the norm.

nodes.name: Sydney
nodes.description: Harbour city with Opera House and coastal walks.

metadata.overview: Apply for ETA/eVisitor before flying. Opal card covers trains, ferries, and buses. Sun protection is critical; seasons are reversed from the Northern Hemisphere.

nodes.name: Istanbul
nodes.description: Bridge between Europe and Asia with bazaars and mosques.

metadata.overview: Get an e-Visa online, haggle politely in bazaars, and remove shoes at mosques. Hagia Sophia and Grand Bazaar are must-sees — go early.

nodes.name: Bangkok
nodes.description: Temples, street food, and vibrant night markets.

metadata.overview: Dress modestly at wats, use Grab/BTS, and drink bottled water. Songkran (Apr) and cool season (Nov–Feb) are popular travel windows.

nodes.name: Singapore
nodes.description: Clean garden city and Asian food capital.

metadata.overview: Most nationalities get visa-free entry. MRT is efficient; chewing gum and litter fines are strict. Book Gardens by the Bay in advance.
Book ferries/flights early for summer. Oia sunsets draw crowds — arrive hours ahead. Sturdy shoes for cobblestones and steps.

nodes.name: Machu Picchu
nodes.description: Inca citadel in the Andes cloud forest.

metadata.overview: Permits and train tickets sell out months ahead. Acclimatize in Cusco (3,400 m) before the trek. Dry season (May–Sep) is peak.
Confirm resort transfer (seaplane/speedboat) when booking. Pack reef-safe sunscreen. Dec–Apr is dry season with calm seas for snorkeling.

nodes.name: Kyoto
nodes.description: Geisha districts, bamboo groves, and zen gardens.

metadata.overview: Reserve popular temples (Kiyomizu, Fushimi Inari early AM). Wear easy-remove shoes for tatami. Spring cherry and autumn maple seasons are crowded.
Book Anne Frank House and Rijksmuseum slots weeks ahead. Watch for bikes on paths. OV-chipkaart covers trams and trains.

nodes.name: Los Angeles
nodes.description: Entertainment capital, beaches, and diverse food scenes.

metadata.overview: Rent a car for sprawl; traffic peaks at rush hour. Hiking Griffith Park and studio tours need reservations. Sunscreen year-round.

nodes.name: Cancún
nodes.description: Caribbean beaches and Mayan ruin day trips.

metadata.overview: Use resort zone shuttles or licensed taxis. Hurricane season Jun–Nov — travel insurance recommended. Book Chichen Itzá tours early.

nodes.name: Swiss Alps
nodes.description: Mountain peaks, skiing, and scenic rail journeys.

metadata.overview: Swiss Travel Pass covers trains and many lifts. Layer clothing for altitude swings. Book Jungfraujoch and Glacier Express ahead in peak season.
Rent a 4WD for F-roads in summer only. Weather changes hourly — pack waterproof layers. Book Blue Lagoon and ice cave tours early.
Hire licensed guides at Giza. Dress modestly; stay hydrated. Nile cruise and Luxor extensions need separate bookings.

nodes.name: Kenya Safari
nodes.description: Maasai Mara wildlife and Great Migration.

metadata.overview: Yellow fever certificate may be required. Book lodges inside reserve for early game drives. Jul–Oct for river crossings; Jan–Feb for calving.

nodes.name: Rio de Janeiro
nodes.description: Copacabana beaches, Christ the Redeemer, and samba.

metadata.overview: Stay alert in tourist zones; use registered taxis/ Uber_once. Carnival (Feb/Mar) requires months-ahead planning. Portuguese basics help.
eTA required for visa-exempt flyers. Compass Card for SkyTrain. Stanley Park and Capilano Suspension Bridge are top sights — book Capilano online.

nodes.name: Full Marathon
nodes.description: 26.2-mile road race requiring months of endurance training.

metadata.overview: Follow a 16–20 week plan peaking at 20-mile long runs. Practice race-day fueling every long run. Taper two weeks before event.
8-week plans work for beginners. Include one tempo and one interval session weekly. Hydrate for humid race locations like coastal cities.
12-week training with long runs up to 11–12 miles. Don't skip rest days. Test shoes and socks on longest runs only.

nodes.name: Soccer Tournament
nodes.description: Team football competition requiring agility and stamina.

metadata.overview: Arrive early for dynamic warm-up. Bring extra cleats, shin guards, and hydration. Know substitution and tie-break rules for your bracket.

nodes.name: Basketball League
nodes.description: Indoor or outdoor league play with weekly games.

metadata.overview: Condition with suicides and plyometrics. Ankle braces if injury-prone. Confirm game schedule and playoff format with league admin.

nodes.name: Tennis Championship
nodes.description: Singles or doubles match play tournament.

metadata.overview: Restring racquets before event. Pack extra grips, towels, and electrolytes. Learn tiebreak and let rules for your division.

nodes.name: Open Water Swim
nodes.description: Lake, river, or ocean distance swimming event.

metadata.overview: Practice sighting and drafting in open water. Wetsuit legal per water temp rules. Never swim alone in training.
Build weekly mileage gradually. Practice eating on the bike every 45 minutes. Check tire sealant and carry spare tubes.
Brick workouts (bike then run) are essential. Know transition layout and rack setup. Practice wetsuit removal speed.
Know local rules and pace-of-play policy. Practice lag putting week before. Book practice range slot day prior.

nodes.name: Yoga Retreat
nodes.description: Multi-day yoga intensive or wellness retreat.

metadata.overview: Bring mat, blocks, and comfortable layers. Inform instructors of injuries. Hydrate and ease into advanced poses.

nodes.name: Rock Climbing Expedition
nodes.description: Outdoor sport or trad climbing trip.

metadata.overview: Check harness, helmet, and rope age. Partner checks mandatory. Study route topo and descent plan before climbing.

nodes.name: Ski Season
nodes.description: Alpine skiing vacation or race camp.

metadata.overview: Tune skis before trip. Helmet required. Layer for lift vs run temps. Know avalanche safety if going off-piste.

nodes.name: Cricket Match Series
nodes.description: League or friendly cricket match preparation.

metadata.overview: Break in batting gloves and shoes. Warm up shoulders and core. Know format (T20/ODI) and field restrictions.
Fresh grip tape and non-marking shoes required. Dynamic footwork warm-up prevents ankle rolls. Study opponent if bracket published.

nodes.name: Angiogram
nodes.description: Cardiac catheter imaging of coronary arteries.

metadata.overview: Fast 6–8 hours; inform team of metformin/blood thinners. Arrange ride home; drink fluids post-procedure. Watch puncture site for bleeding.

nodes.name: Colonoscopy
nodes.description: Screening exam of the large intestine.

metadata.overview: Clear-liquid diet day before; complete prep solution on schedule. Sedation — no driving 24 h. Follow polyp removal instructions if applicable.
Remove all metal; inform staff of implants. Claustrophobic patients may request mild sedation. Earplugs provided — exam 30–60 min.
Prehab strengthening 4–6 weeks improves outcomes. Home safety prep (rails, raised toilet seat). PT starts day 1 post-op.
Use prescribed drops starting days before. No food morning of surgery. Sunglasses and shield at night post-op.
Pack hospital bag by week 36. Birth plan copies for team. Install car seat; know labor triage criteria.

nodes.name: Dental Implant
nodes.description: Titanium post placement for tooth replacement.

metadata.overview: Antibiotic prophylaxis if directed. Soft diet 1–2 weeks. No straws or smoking — protects clot.
Low-fat diet pre-op if instructed. Arrange help first 48 h home. Incision care — no heavy lifting 4–6 weeks.
Stop blood thinners per surgeon schedule. Support garment may be provided. Gradual return to activity per protocol.
Home modifications reduce fall risk. Hip precautions (no bending past 90°) if posterior approach. Walker/cane training pre-op helps.
Stop contacts 2+ weeks before (varies by lens type). No makeup day of surgery. Drops schedule strict first month.
Schedule after menstrual period for comfort. No deodorant day of exam. Bring prior images if changing facilities.
NPO if acute symptoms — surgery urgent. Post-op early ambulation prevents ileus. Incision infection signs to report.
Port care education if applicable. Anti-nausea meds filled before cycle 1. Low neutrophil precautions explained by oncology nurse.
Fistula maturation takes weeks — protect arm from BP cuffs and needles. Diet phosphorus/potassium limits. Session schedule 3× weekly typical.
NPO midnight before; morning meds with sip of water if approved. Throat numbness wears off — soft foods rest of day.
Hold anticoagulants per plan. Arm sling 2–4 weeks on implant side. MRI-conditional device card provided.
Pelvic floor exercises pre/post-op. Catheter care instructions. Pathology follow-up appointment scheduled.
Take antibiotics if prescribed before visit. Soft diet after temp crown. Complete permanent crown within recommended window.
Stop NSAIDs/ blood thinners if surgeon advises. Keep bandage dry 24 h. Results typically 7–10 business days.

nodes.name: Tonsillectomy
nodes.description: Tonsil removal for chronic infection or sleep apnea.

metadata.overview: Hydration critical — ice chips and popsicles help. Avoid red foods (can't see bleeding). Pain peaks days 5–7.
Supportive underwear day of procedure. Ice first 48 h. Alternate contraception until semen analysis confirms azoospermia.

nodes.name: Wisdom Teeth Removal
nodes.description: Third molar extraction under local or general anesthesia.

metadata.overview: No straws/smoking 5–7 days (dry socket risk). Soft foods and oral rinse as directed. Swelling peaks day 2–3.

nodes.name: ACL Reconstruction
nodes.description: Knee ligament repair after sports injury.

metadata.overview: Prehab quad activation improves outcomes. Brace and crutches training pre-op. PT protocol phased over 6–9 months.
Pulmonary toilet exercises pre-op. Sternotomy precautions — no lifting >10 lb 6 weeks. Cardiac rehab referral standard.

nodes.name: GRE Exam
nodes.description: Graduate Record Examination for US grad schools.

metadata.overview: 8–12 week study plan; ETS PowerPrep for baseline. AWA templates for issue/argument. Scores valid 5 years.
Data Insights section is new focus area. Official practice exams 2–3 before test day. Time management per section critical.
Digital adaptive format — practice on Bluebook app. Math formula sheet provided. Reading paired passages strategy matters.
Science is data interpretation, not memorization. Faster pace than SAT — drill timing. Superscore policies vary by college.
Speaking mock tests weekly. Writing Task 1 graph vocabulary lists. Listening accents vary — practice BBC/podcasts.
Integrated speaking/writing tasks combine reading+listening. Note templates for lecture summaries. Home edition rules differ.
Prelims MCQ + Mains descriptive + Interview. NCERT foundation then standard books. Answer writing practice daily.
Bar review course structured schedule. MBE practice 50+ Q/day. State-specific components (MEE/MPT) need separate prep.
Four sections — plan order (FAR/AUD/REG/BEC successor). 18-month window once first pass. Simulations practice essential.
35 contact hours required. PMBOK + Agile Practice Guide. Process groups and ITTOs — use flashcards.
Hands-on free tier labs reinforce VPC, IAM, S3 patterns. Exam is scenario-heavy — eliminate wrong answers.
Qwiklabs for Compute Engine and GKE basics. gcloud CLI practice. Case studies on Google exam site.
Next Gen format — case studies and bow-tie items. UWorld or similar QBank daily. Computer adaptive test — stay calm if questions feel harder.
Content review 3 mo + FL exams monthly. CARS daily practice non-negotiable. AAMC materials closest to real exam.
Logic games elimination strategies evolving post-format changes. Blind review of missed questions. PT under timed conditions weekly.
300+ hour guideline. Ethics always tested — don't skip. Calculator policy strict (BA II Plus allowed).

nodes.name: Driving License Test
nodes.description: DMV written and road skills examination.

metadata.overview: State handbook read twice. Parallel parking and mirror checks for road test. Documents: ID, insurance, registration.
Complete accredited pre-licensing hours. Practice national + state law exams. Background check and sponsorship for activation.
Committee questions on methods and limitations. Defense slides 45–60 min. Mock defense with lab peers.
Housing deposit and course registration deadlines. Health insurance waiver or campus plan. Budget textbooks vs rentals.
Visa and course credit approval early. Host university course catalog review. Travel insurance and phone plan.
Prework completion before day 1. Git/GitHub daily. Job prep starts mid-program — portfolio projects.
Python/pandas + SQL proficiency. Capstone with real dataset. Statistics fundamentals for interviews.
Two-day course mandatory. Scrum Guide read cover-to-cover. Servant leadership scenarios for exam.
Content area exam + pedagogy test. Student teaching documentation. Background check and fingerprinting.

nodes.description: Medical evacuation and trip cancellation cover
